subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark(?) in the following equation?

3 × 16.13 + 15.03 – 7.86 + sqrt{15} = ?
solution:
Given:

3 × 16.13 + 15.03 – 7.86 + sqrt{15}

Calculation:

Approximating the values we get,

3 × 16 + 15 - 8 + √16

⇒ 48 + 15 - 8 + 4

⇒ 59

Option 3 i.e. 61 is the closest possible number to 59.

**∴ The value of 3 × 16.13 + 15.03 – 7.86 + sqrt{15} is 59.**
